items.title: Admissions Open
items.detail: Admissions are open. Visit our campus or contact the admission office to learn more about eligibility, the admission process, and fee structure.

items.title: School Office Hours
items.detail: Parents and guardians are requested to visit the school office during official working hours for admissions or fee queries.

items.title: NOTICE TO PARENTS
items.detail:
Dear Parents,

We are pleased to inform you that the upcoming program (Mom & Me) is not only about the entrance fee. It is also an opportunity for our parents and your ward to participate, enjoy, and showcase your talents.

To make the program more special and memorable, we have arranged beautiful gifts for all the participants as a token of appreciation for their enthusiastic participation.

We warmly encourage all parents to support to take part in the program.

 Thank you for your kind support and cooperation.

 School Administration
